definition.en: The rocky outer layer of Earth, whose thickness varies between places.
definition.zh: 地球最外面的岩石层，各处厚度不同。

definition.en: The region of mostly solid rock between the crust and the core; its rock can deform over geological time.
definition.zh: 地壳与地核之间、大部分为固态岩石的区域；岩石能在地质时间尺度上变形。

definition.en: The crust and rigid uppermost mantle together, divided into moving plates.
definition.zh: 地壳和刚性的最上部地幔合成的整体，分成移动的板块。

definition.en: A moving block of lithosphere that may include both continental and oceanic parts.
definition.zh: 移动的岩石圈块体，可以同时包括大陆与海洋部分。

definition.en: The region of solid metal at the centre of Earth.
definition.zh: 位于地球中心的固态金属区域。

definition.en: The region of liquid metal surrounding the inner core.
definition.zh: 包围内核的液态金属区域。

definition.en: Molten rock material below the surface, which can contain crystals and dissolved gas.
definition.zh: 位于地表下的熔融岩石物质，可以含晶体和溶解气体。

definition.en: Molten rock that has erupted onto the surface.
definition.zh: 已经喷出到地表的熔融岩石。

definition.en: The descent of one lithospheric plate beneath another plate.
definition.zh: 一块岩石圈板块向另一板块下方下降的过程。

definition.en: An opening through which volcanic gas, fragments and/or lava reach the surface or atmosphere.
definition.zh: 火山气体、碎屑和／或熔岩到达地表或大气的开口。

definition.en: A fracture surface along which rocks can move relative to each other.
definition.zh: 岩体可以沿着相对移动的破裂面。

definition.en: The place inside Earth where an earthquake rupture begins.
definition.zh: 地球内部一次地震破裂开始的位置。

definition.en: The point on the surface directly above the focus.
definition.zh: 震源在地表正上方的位置。

definition.en: A seismic wave in which particles vibrate parallel to the direction the wave travels.
definition.zh: 质点振动方向与传播方向平行的地震波。

definition.en: A seismic wave in which particles vibrate perpendicular to the travel direction; it does not travel directly through the liquid outer core.
definition.zh: 质点振动方向垂直于传播方向的地震波，不能直接穿过液态外核。

definition.en: A series of long waves caused by a large, sudden displacement of water, unrelated to tides.
definition.zh: 大量水体突然位移产生的长波列，与潮汐不同。
